android.desc:
We offer two sharing modes to fit your needs:                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                    
Peer-to-Peer Mode
- No login required — start sharing instantly
- Files transfer directly, never passing through a server
- Perfect for real-time sharing when the recipient is online
- Completely free with no size limits

Cloud Upload Mode
- Requires member login
- Files are uploaded to a cloud server
- Generates a share link the recipient can download anytime
- Customizable retention period (3 hours to 30 days)
- Ideal for sharing with friends who aren't online right now

Key Features
- Share individual files or entire folders
- Optional encrypted transfers to protect your privacy
- Clean, intuitive interface
- Available in Chinese and English

Download now and start sharing!
